turns.speaker: assistant

Plus, my morning got completely derailed because my roommate's fancy new espresso machine broke, so I couldn't even get my usual iced americano. I had to settle for brewing some green tea instead.

turns.text: Thanks! The bread turned out really well in this batch. We actually haven't done much wedding planning this week. Tom and I are taking a little break from all the venue searching because it was getting a bit overwhelming, so we'll dive back into it next month.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Taking a break sounds like a very healthy choice. It's easy to get overwhelmed by all those details. Did you have any entertainment for your rideshare commute this morning to distract you from the ankle pain?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I finally started listening to that unsolved cases podcast my coworker recommended a while back. I was completely hooked the whole ride.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, the true-crime one! It sounds like it's as gripping as they said. Has it lived up to the hype so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. I'm already looking forward to the ride home so I can listen to the next episode. It definitely made the traffic here in Tucson feel much shorter!
